name: session-fleet
description: Claude Code sessions that start and manage other sessions, with the session-cap plugin they build on.

plugins.name: session-fleet
plugins.description: Sessions that start other sessions and manage them: a manager role, background sessions per ticket or per prompt, sessions joining a manager, successors started at handover, and a board of the whole fleet. Builds on session-cap.

plugins.name: session-cap
plugins.description: A per-session context cap (200k tokens by default): a Stop hook that trips once at the cap, a /handover skill that writes a handover document from disk, a ledger, a context report and a status line.
